retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the Council of Europe and UNESCO convention of 11 April 1997 on the recognition of higher-education qualifications in the European region. Lisbon was the venue and Portugal was the host, and neither is a causal part of the thing. The atlas is about Portugal, and a treaty that happens to be signed here belongs to the history of what it settles; there is nothing in the atlas for it to attach to in either direction.
